data.name: Fikriah
data.gender_notes: Fikriah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who has a deep understanding and knowledge of something. A thinker, a philosopher. The name Fikriah carries the meaning “Intellect, wisdom, thought” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fikriah usually hope their child will grow to embody intellect, wisdom, thought and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encouragement for intellectual and spiritual growth
data.etymology: Fikriah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intellect, wisdom, thought.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fikriah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: فكرية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الفكر، يعني التفكير العميق والتأمل
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فكرية مشتق من الفكر، وهو يعني التفكير العميق والتأمل في الأمور، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات في سياق التفكير في خلق الله وتأمل في آياته، مثل في سورة آل عمران: 'أَفَلَا يَتَفَكَرُونَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ أَمْ عَلَى قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَا'

in_urdu.name: فکریہ
in_urdu.meaning: فکر سے بنا ہوا، گہرا سوچنا اور غور کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام فکریہ فکر سے ماخوذ ہے، جو کہ گہرا سوچنا اور غور کرنا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی تقالید میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ فکریہ نام کی لڑکیاں سوچ سمجھ کر کام کرتی ہیں اور غور و فکر کے بعد فیصلے کرتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: फिक्रिया
in_hindi.meaning: विचार से बना, गहराई से सोचना और विचार करना
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम फिक्रिया विचार से बना है, जिसका अर्थ है गहराई से सोचना और विचार करना। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है। फिक्रिया नाम की लड़कियां सोच-समझकर काम करती हैं और विचार करने के बाद निर्णय लेती हैं।

in_pashto.name: فکرې
in_pashto.meaning: د فکر څخه مشتق شوی، چې معنی یې ده ژوره سوچ او پام
in_pashto.long_meaning: د فکرې نوم د فکر څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د ژورې سوچ او پام معنی لري. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او په اسلامي دود کې مهم دی. فکرې نومې نجونې د سوچ او پاملرنې سره سم کار کوي او د پريکړو کولو لپاره يې وخت نیسي.

in_english.name: Fikriah
in_english.meaning: derived from thought, deep thinking, and contemplation
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fikriah is derived from the Arabic root 'fikr', which means thought, deep thinking, and contemplation. This name is significant in Islamic tradition as it reflects the importance of reflection and consideration in one's actions and decisions. The name Fikriah is mentioned in the Quran in various contexts, emphasizing the need for believers to reflect on the signs of Allah and ponder on the Quran. The name symbolizes wisdom, prudence, and a thoughtful approach to life.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fikriah holds great significance in Islamic culture. It is a reflection of a deep thinker, someone who is knowledgeable, introspective, and committed to learning. In many Islamic societies, the pursuit of knowledge is highly valued and revered, especially in the areas of philosophy, theology, and spirituality. The name Fikriah could be seen as a symbol of this cultural value, representing a person who dedicates their life to understanding the world around them and seeking wisdom.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Fikriah can be seen as a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and understanding in our lives. In Islamic teachings, knowledge is considered a gift from God and a means to draw closer to Him. The name Fikriah can be seen as a reminder to always strive for deeper understanding, not just of the physical world around us, but also of the spiritual realm, and the divine truths that lie within. It is a name that inspires one to be a seeker of truth, a lifelong learner, and a devoted servant of God.
